title: Quiet working time for two
description: Agree on a session and see each other’s presence, with no compulsory chat and no competition.

blocks.text: Two people choose a start time and see that the other has begun their own work too. During the session there is no need to talk, to turn on a competition or to explain every pause.

quote.text: The body doubling aspect is very helpful and I have digital study buddies around the globe now!

blocks.text: The first version can be tested on a pair who know each other: an invitation, a shared start and an unobtrusive presence. One participant being late does not block the other’s work, and conversation stays outside the boundaries of the stretch.
Not building a chat on top of the work

Value in its own right will appear if people really do come back to an arrangement like this. If an ordinary reminder to each other is enough for them, a large social platform will add more upkeep than support.
